g.text: What drives the larger third-image weight updates?

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: Memory filtering reconstructed from all saved bins. Each bar separates components along the observed update direction.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: Positive bars align with the recorded update; negative bars oppose it. Component norms are not additive.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: Each condition uses its own recorded firing. This algebra does not predict the effect of removing a component in a running brain.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da

g.text: All 36 observations / 1,800 bins checked; this figure shows image 3. No clipping occurred in these recordings.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #b9c6da
